_doc: Not an asset (files starting with _ are skipped). Grass / ground-cover assets: src/render/vgeo/grass_asset.h documents every key; docs/FOLIAGE_GRASS.md the shading. Densities are clumps per m2 at full density per terrain material (MgMaterial names), x the clumping keep rate (mean about 0.6), x the fidelity level's density, x r_foliage_density.
_doc_ao: shading.ao_strength (0..1, default 0.3): weight of the screen-space AO on the cards (lerp(1, ao, s)); 0 = none. shading.ao_combine: "min" (default) or "multiply" for the clump AO (ao_root, the nta map's AO) against the screen-space AO. docs/RENDERING_POST.md "Foliage-aware AO".
_doc_shadow_class: shadow_class: the sun shadow caster class (render/shadow_casters.h, assets/render/shadow_casters.json, docs/SHADOWS.md "Caster cascade limits"): "ground" (default: grass, ground cover; the near cascade only), "small" (ferns, reeds, shrubs, wheat; the near cascades), "tree" or "none" (every cascade).
